name: Photo Collection
description: The second clip flies in as a photo, spinning, and lands tilted on top of the first: chain it to stack photos. At `progress` 1 the photo lies on the first clip, so the result is not the second clip alone. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: progress
params.description: 0 = first clip, 1 = the photo has landed on the first clip

params.name: direction
params.description: Where the photo comes from: 0 left, 1 right, 2 top, 3 bottom

params.name: angle
params.description: Tilt of the photo once it lands, in degrees

params.name: spins
params.description: Turns during the flight (negative: the other way)

params.name: size
params.description: Photo size, border included: it fits inside this part of the frame

params.name: border
params.description: Photo border, relative to the frame height
